name: BSDS500: The Berkeley Segmentation Dataset and Benchmark
description: The Berkeley Segmentation Dataset and Benchmark 500 (BSDS500) is a gold-standard computer vision benchmark for natural image boundary detection and segmentation. Consisting of 500 images explicitly partitioned into 200 train, 100 validation, and 200 test images, each annotated with multiple independent human ground truth segmentations.
